gumtree_entries.description:
UPDATED o1 -> i5: Header-ID of a ZipExtraField not supported by Commons Compress.

Used to be ZipShort(1) but this is the ID of the Zip64 extra field.

ADDED i1: Tests {@link ExtraFieldUtils#parse} when told to {@code READ} extra-field blocks that it cannot fully parse.

Each ZIP extra field is laid out as:
ADDED i2: Size in bytes of the header-id portion of an extra field.
ADDED i3: Size in bytes of the data-length portion of an extra field.
ADDED i4: Size in bytes of an extra field's fixed prefix (header id + data length).
ADDED i6: Expected Unix mode of the directory entry: octal 0755 with the directory flag set.
ADDED i7: Concatenated local-file-data bytes of {@link #asiField} followed by {@link #unrecognizedField}.
ADDED i8: A recognized extra field: a directory with Unix permissions 0755.
ADDED i9: An extra field whose header id is unknown to Commons Compress.
ADDED i10: Serializes the given fields into a single byte array using the local-file-data layout ({@code header id | data length | data} per field).
ADDED i11: Complete data: both fields are well-formed, so the unrecognized field is returned as an UnrecognizedExtraField holding its single data byte.
ADDED i12: Truncated data: drop the very last byte so the second field's declared length exceeds the bytes actually present. With READ, the leftover bytes are captured ver
ADDED i13: The unparseable holder keeps the 4 trailing bytes (header id + length of the truncated second field) exactly as they appeared in the input.
